screening_method_note: This pass is a heuristic first-pass screen of every `description` value against a bounded, documented term list (the 20 canonical core Golarion deities named in docs/governance/ogl-pi-blacklist.md's operating cycle brief), plus a broader capitalized-word frequency sample taken across all 3326 records during authoring to surface any other clearly-named NPC or Golarion place proper noun. Zero matches were found in either pass for this book -- consistent with Paizo's own choice to keep the Core Rulebook's spell/equipment mechanical text setting-neutral. This is NOT an exhaustive human legal review; it is a bounded substring/regex scan against ~20 known names and does not prove the absence of PI beyond what that scan can see.
